tasks.title: Fix the test-harness defect in src/policy_platform/api/routers/ai.py
tasks.classification: real defect; pre-existing; deliberately left unfixed under scope discipline
tasks.root_cause: The test harness never patches get_settings on the api.routers.ai module, so the affected tests read ambient environment configuration and fail with HTTP 503 from Azure OpenAI.
tasks.fix_direction: Patch get_settings on the api.routers.ai module inside the fixture so the tests stop depending on ambient environment.
constraints: Do NOT fold into feature work.
Do NOT dismiss the 9 failures as merely environmental - the standing rule is to check ambient environment inheritance before calling a failure environmental, and that is exactly what exposed this.
